steps.name: raw-metric-census-guard
ac: test -f apps/api/tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 3

cd apps/api && uv run python -c "from tests.common.test_metric_safety_guard import all_metric_sites, raw_metric_sites; import sys; sys.exit(0 if len(all_metric_sites())>=30 and len(raw_metric_sites())==15 else 1)"
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src

steps.name: wrap-raw-metric-sites
ac: cd apps/api && uv run python -c "from tests.common.test_metric_safety_guard import all_metric_sites, raw_metric_sites; import sys; sys.exit(0 if len(all_metric_sites())>=30 and len(raw_metric_sites())==0 else 1)"
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py -q
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/tasks/live_signal.py tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py

steps.name: ledger-seed-watermark-write
ac: test "$(grep -c '_qb_ledger_seed_since' apps/api/src/tasks/live_signal.py)" -ge 2
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q -k 'seed or watermark or gap'
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q -k 'ledger_seed_watermark' --collect-only 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 2
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/tasks/live_signal.py

steps.name: ledger-seed-rederive-each-tick
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q -k 'ledger_seed_watermark'
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q -k 'ledger_seed_watermark' --collect-only 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 4
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/tasks/live_signal.py

steps.name: mutation-selfcheck
ac: cd apps/api && uv run python -c "from tests.common.test_metric_safety_guard import all_metric_sites, raw_metric_sites; import sys; sys.exit(0 if len(all_metric_sites())>=30 and len(raw_metric_sites())==0 else 1)"
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py tests/tasks -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/tasks/live_signal.py tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py
cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check tests/common/test_metric_safety_guard.py
